⏳ *Checking non-runner frames for false positives...*
I have created and verified [jump_analyzer.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g8yx5oak/jump_analyzer.py) (mounted at `/app/jump_analyzer.py` inside the container) and generated [output.toml](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g8yx5oak/output.toml) (`/app/output.toml`).

### How It Works
1. **Camera Jitter Compensation & Background Subtraction**: [`analyze_video`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g8yx5oak/jump_analyzer.py#L8-L133) aligns each frame to the empty initial frame (`frame 0`) via subpixel phase correlation (`cv2.phaseCorrelate`) on static top and bottom background strips, then segments the athlete on the track (`y ∈ [238, 400]`) while compensating for any global illumination shifts.
2. **Hurdle Clearance & Ground Contact Detection**: The script locates the jump apex over the hurdle (`x ∈ [430, 570], y ∈ [120, 320]`) and tracks the athlete's lowest foot position (`y_max`) relative to the local track ground level before and after the hurdle to identify the takeoff frame (`jump_takeoff_frame_number`) and landing frame (`jump_land_frame_number`).
3. **Output**: Running on `/app/example_video.mp4` produces `/app/output.toml`:
   ```toml
   jump_takeoff_frame_number = 53
   jump_land_frame_number = 62
   ```
